dedupe_keys.name: application to visualize leap rpi 2020 centrifuge data

description: Application to Visualize LEAP-RPI-2020 Centrifuge Data is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Mourad Zeghal, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (rpi.edu). This standalone application allows users to visualize the results of the centrifuge tests conducted as part of LEAP-RPI-2020 (see the link to the data in Related Data and Software). The application prompts the user to select one of the LEAP universities and one of the centrifuge tests conducted at the corresponding facility. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-z1ny-9p72. Keywords: Standalone MATLAB APP, Centrifuge Data, Visualizations, Liquefaction, Sheet-Pile Wall, Soil-Structure Interaction.. Published 2023-12-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
